assessments.reasoning: The NIST official legacy archive hosts the NBS publication. Its title and foreword identify the committee materials and their original approved release dates. The captured complete source exactly matches the registered digest ed60a71b77cb98a49267334b38fc334a7fcf4365dd593a8e467ac83ba363b780. The identified controlling passage is Title and foreword, PDF pages 3 and 5; Part I §1.1 at PDF page 15. The January 1976 NBS Handbook 118 presents MUMPS as a programming language and publishes a MUMPS Development Committee language specification. The identity decision concerns MUMPS as the language. Later standards and the name M require separate sources. The foreword separates narrative specification, formal diagrams, and portability requirements by document number and committee release date.
